about: Worker B, custodial slow fade (coordinator approved Nov 16): one launch per rtx.volumetrics.maxAccumulationFrames value at con_custodial, set explicitly in every variant so remix-dxvk.log proves each was read (128 is Remix's default; play-setup rtx.conf does not set it). Each launch: the bench window at y0_p0 with the room lit (its frames/bench.gray gives the still-camera noise, the cost), then the light switch with dumps at 1 and 18 s (frames/light_switch.gray gives the fade). Remix blends fog history with weight 1/(age+5), age capped at N, so if fog history is the cause the fade time constant scales with N+5: 64 -> 0.52x, 32 -> 0.28x, 16 -> 0.155x the base. Scored by tools/remix/.amp/in/workerB/fog_fade.py <run folder>. 01_base only (coordinator approved, no extra launch): once the fade has settled (the switch window holds 20 s, then 5 s more), StandInSkipSamGear base / sam_gear / base_again in the dark room, each proven by its reload line and 2 stray lines.
